name: circles_small
desc: AA discs of radius 0.5..21 at integer and fractional centres

name: circles_large
desc: Discs radius 34, 55, 89, 144 and 200 (large AA edge length)

name: circle_strokes
desc: Stroked circles, widths 0.25..14, radius 3..60

name: lines_thin
desc: Hairline-to-thick strokes: axis aligned at fractional positions, diagonals

name: caps_joins
desc: All 3 caps x 3 joins on sharp, right, obtuse polylines, miter limits, closed paths

name: zero_length
desc: Degenerate subpaths: dot with round/square cap, nothing with butt, zero-length closed

name: dashes
desc: setLineDash patterns and offsets on lines, circles, ellipses, closed rect, caps

name: ellipses_arcs
desc: Rotated ellipses, partial arcs, anticlockwise, sweeps > 2pi, arc after lineTo

name: curves
desc: quadratic star (as in the app), bezier, arcTo, nested closed paths, nonzero winding

name: roundrects
desc: roundRect: radii 0..huge, array radii, negative size, fill/stroke, shadows off

name: clipping
desc: clip rect, circle, nested, evenodd, with transforms, strokes and gradients inside

name: gradients_linear
desc: 2-3 stop, alpha stops (transparent black), reversed, equal offsets, padding, degenerate, under CTM

name: gradients_radial
desc: concentric, off-centre inner circle, r0=0, alpha halo ending in transparent black, r0>r1

name: shadows_fill
desc: shadowBlur 0/6/8/18 on fills, coloured and translucent shadows, offsets, gradient fill, alpha

name: shadows_stroke
desc: stroked shadows: round caps, dashed rails with glow, rim glow with blur 18

name: alpha_stacking
desc: globalAlpha steps, nested alpha x colour alpha, overlapping fill+stroke, rgba quantisation

name: shear_transforms
desc: transform(1,0,-0.22,1,0,0), nested rotate/scale/translate on rects, strokes, circles

name: state_stack
desc: save/restore of style, dash, shadow, alpha, transform; rect/clearRect; invalid lineWidth ignored

name: text_fonts
desc: every ctx.font used by the app (and Nunito 800, Fredoka 400): centre aligned, middle and alphabetic

name: text_align_baseline
desc: left/center/right/start/end and alphabetic/middle/top/bottom/ideographic/hanging at fractional positions

name: text_stroke_scale
desc: strokeText + fillText with scale 1.3 as the floating text does, rotated text, thin/wide outlines

name: text_emoji
desc: emoji runs (SPEC 6.2): hub labels, gate labels, floating text, all baselines, strokeText skips emoji

name: drawimage
desc: drawImage 3/5/9-arg forms: upscale, downscale 64->13px (as the emoji), rotation, alpha, smoothing off, emoji sprites
